exact_year_alignment_test.mark_pattern_year_assignment: All 7! = 5,040 one-to-one permutations of observed seven year-specific source natal marked nestling count vectors across fixed observed recipient-year labels
exact_year_alignment_test.measured_score: mean observed next-year recorded migrant-destination logloss using previously frozen 1994–2013 historic model and permuted current source nestling counts; compare to fixed static prediction
exact_year_alignment_test.primary_route: R2 symmetric historical pair mobility smoothed to historical same-farm habitat H, tau=10
exact_year_alignment_test.evidence_metric: rank/percentile of correctly aligned seven years among all 5040 labels, INCLUDING observed matching alignment; descriptive only, NOT randomization p-value; years not exchangeable due secular trends/effort
exact_year_alignment_test.year_omission: Report all 7 single-year and all 21 two-year removals of observed-aligned yearly loss contributions; check total 173 documented emigrants; no favorable deletion promoted
exact_year_alignment_test.source_island_ablation: For each of all 11 natal source islands individually, replace ONLY its later 7 observed marked-nestling annual volumes by that island's historical mean; leave every other source's supply dynamic, and hold yields + historical routing unchanged. Compare to all-dynamic loss. This is predictor-state ablation, NOT actual population deletion.
exact_year_alignment_test.report_full: Four route rank distributions (summary counts, min, max, median, matching rank); per-year and all single/double year omissions; all eleven source ablations; no subgroup p or posthoc threshold.

requirements_and_STOP.if_any_anchor_drift: STOP instead of changing data or excluding unfavorable years
